caption: The drawing consists of a square composition featuring a pattern resembling a quilt block. At the center, there is a small square with a red background and a repeating yellow floral motif. Surrounding this center square, there are successively larger rectangular strips arranged in a clockwise pattern. The first strip on the left is brown with small blue dots. The next strip at the bottom has a cream color with green leafy stems and red flowers. The right side strip is light green with diagonal white branches and small red dots. The subsequent strip on the top is beige with thin blue diagonal lines, followed by another strip on the right that is similar but thinner. The next strip is light yellow with green diagonal lines and small red dots, and then a larger strip with a black background and slanted yellow lines. Following is a wide strip with a brown background and a paisley pattern in red, white, blue, and yellow. The next two strips, one thinner and one wide, repeat the paisley and the green leafy branch motif, respectively. All strips are precisely aligned to form a continuous square rotation, and the entire composition is bordered by a thin red double line. The background is cream-colored and plain, with the main pattern sitting in the center of the image.
title: Log Cabin Quilt Square
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
